text:
**Change:** The only error was ERC: the start-up pull-up devices used L = 30 µm, but the maximum allowed is 20 µm. I replaced the three L = 30 µm series PMOS with five L = 20 µm series PMOS. That gives an effective W/L of 0.42/100, about the same as the previous 0.42/90. The start-up pull-up current therefore stays just as weak (nA-level), so the power budget and the turn-off behaviour are unchanged. The core, the output network and the start-up sense devices are unchanged.

```spice
.subckt dut vdd vref vss
* ---- PTAT beta-multiplier core (weak inversion) ----
M1   n1  n1  vss vss nfet W=8 L=2
M2   pg  n1  ns  vss nfet W=8 L=2 m=8
Rs   ns  vss 150k
M3   n1  pg  vdd vdd pfet W=4 L=2
M4   pg  pg  vdd vdd pfet W=4 L=2
Cpg  vdd pg  1p
* ---- output: PTAT current into fractional bandgap network ----
M5   vref pg vdd vdd pfet W=4 L=2 m=2
Rb   vref vss 800k
Ra   vref e3  570k
Q3   vss vss e3 pnp m=1
* ---- start-up: weak pull-up (5x L=20 series), sensed by core mirror, full turn-off ----
Mpu1 sx  vss vdd vdd pfet W=0.42 L=20
Mpu2 sy  vss sx  vdd pfet W=0.42 L=20
Mpu3 sz  vss sy  vdd pfet W=0.42 L=20
Mpu4 sw  vss sz  vdd pfet W=0.42 L=20
Mpu5 st  vss sw  vdd pfet W=0.42 L=20
Msd  st  n1  vss vss nfet W=8 L=2
Mst  pg  st  vss vss nfet W=1 L=1
.ends
```
